name: Tosted
ingredients_raw: Refined wheat flour (maida) (71%), sugar, refined palm and palmolein oil, semolina (suji) (1.8%), yeast, vital gluten, colour (150a), invert sugar syrup, iodised salt, emulsifiers (472e, 471), spice (0.3%) (green cardamom seeds), bread improver {starch, soya flour, improvers [1100(i), 1104, 1102]}, wheat fibre, nature identical & artificial (milk) flavouring substances and antioxidant (300).
